fields.summary_ko.0: Eli Lilly (LLY) has a P/E of 46.1x, higher than S&P 500's 21.9x, and requires more than 2x revenue growth over the next 6 years to maintain current stock price.
fields.summary_ko.1: In Q3 2026, Mounjaro and Zepbound two new drugs generated more than $16 billion in revenue, and with US market share at approximately one-tenth level, additional growth potential exists.
